about: The offertorium of the formulary “Vigil of Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.translation: Send forth Your Spirit, and they will be created, and You will renew the face of the earth; may the glory of the Lord endure forever, alleluia.

alignments.gloss: may the glory of the Lord endure

w005.explanation: The implied plural subject is the creatures, not the Holy Spirit. The prayer recalls God’s creation and renewal of the earth.
